figs.name: electrical-regulations-and-standards-compliance-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart showing when an electrical standard becomes mandatory through a regulation
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how a published standard stays voluntary practice until a regulation references it, then becomes mandatory and is checked by inspections.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 540" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart showing when an electrical standard becomes mandatory through a regulation</title>
<rect width="800" height="540" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">When Does a Standard Become Mandatory?</text>
<rect x="200" y="62" width="400" height="56" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="84.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Standards body publishes</text>
<text x="400.0" y="108.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">IEC, IEEE, NFPA, ISO or BIS</text>
<line x1="400" y1="118" x2="400" y2="140" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="200" y="140" width="400" height="56" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="162.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Accepted engineering practice</text>
<text x="400.0" y="186.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">for design, testing, installation</text>
<line x1="400" y1="196" x2="400" y2="216" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,218.0 570.0,270 400,322.0 230.0,270" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="265.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Referenced by</text>
<text x="400" y="287.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">a regulation?</text>
<line x1="230" y1="270" x2="175" y2="270" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="205" y="258" font-size="18" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="20" y="236" width="155" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="97.5" y="265.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Voluntary</text>
<text x="97.5" y="289.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">good practice</text>
<line x1="570" y1="270" x2="625" y2="270" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="597" y="258" font-size="18" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="625" y="236" width="155" height="70" rx="10" fill="#b45309" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="702.5" y="265.15" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Mandatory</text>
<text x="702.5" y="290.15" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">by law</text>
<line x1="702" y1="306" x2="702" y2="350" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="500" y="350" width="280" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="640.0" y="379.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Inspections and approvals</text>
<text x="640.0" y="403.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">check compliance</text>
<line x1="640" y1="420" x2="640" y2="445" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="500" y="445" width="280" height="60" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="640.0" y="481.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Violations: penalties</text>
<rect x="20" y="350" width="440" height="155" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="240.0" y="385.8" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Regulation vs standard</text>
<text x="240.0" y="409.8" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Regulation: legal duty, government</text>
<text x="240.0" y="433.8" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Standard: technical method, expert body</text>
<text x="240.0" y="457.8" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Many national rules are based</text>
<text x="240.0" y="481.8" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">on IEC standards</text>
</svg>
